name: Etham
overview: Etham is identified in Scripture as the second camping place of the Israelites during their journey from Egypt, situated at the edge of the wilderness. Both Exodus 13:20 and Numbers 33:6 describe the Israelites departing from Succoth and encamping in Etham, indicating its strategic position as a transitional point in their journey. Numbers 33:7 further records their departure from Etham as they moved toward Pihahiroth, underscoring Etham’s role within the ordered progression of God’s guidance for His people during the Exodus.
